findings.title: Missing Secret servicenow/k8s-informer-repo-cred referenced by 1 pod(s)
findings.summary: Secret "k8s-informer-repo-cred" does not exist in servicenow but 1 running pod(s) reference it (image pull secret). They keep running now and will fail to start when recreated (rollout, reschedule, node replacement). 1/1 have their images already pulled on their current node.
evidence: Secret servicenow/k8s-informer-repo-cred: absent (the secret list was collected successfully)
referenced via image pull secret by: k8s-informer-prod-5b7d96f597-mmvhp
FailedToRetrieveImagePullSecret x27816 on k8s-informer-prod-5b7d96f597-mmvhp: Unable to retrieve some image pull secrets (k8s-informer-repo-cred); attempting to pull the image may not succeed.
first seen 28d ago

steps.description: Confirm it is absent and see which pods need it
steps.command: kubectl get secret k8s-informer-repo-cred -n servicenow -o name

steps.description: Recreate Secret "k8s-informer-repo-cred" through its normal provisioning path (operator, pipeline or secret sync), or remove the stale reference from the workload

verify: kubectl get secret k8s-informer-repo-cred -n servicenow -o name
kubectl get events -n servicenow --field-selector type=Warning | grep k8s-informer-repo-cred   # should stop growing
